news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.27 (vs ₹1.26 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.27 (up from ₹1.26 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹24.9m (up 3.5% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹16.5m (flat on FY 2025). Profit margin: 66% (down from 68% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 27% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 16% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
